record.question: He knew everything better than anybody else and it was an affront to his ______ vanity that you should disagree with him.
record.explanation: Answer B: overweening. Overweening means excessively confident or presumptuous; “overweening vanity” fits the sentence (B). Independent check: “Overweening vanity” means excessive/proud vanity. Reference: https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/overweening; https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/idiom; https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/clauses. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
